mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives wage inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by > 1% QoQ indicates weakening demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, a hawkish monetary stance combats inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% maintains a positive labor market sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4%.
